evidenceNotes: Research and design milestone only. No proposed generator, validator, scoring mechanic or new asset is implemented.
The research script compares 82 original production/test/design inputs to the actual stable main baseline, including all gameplay and presentation sources, assets and dependency manifests.

Baseline observations call the real ObstacleField at 120Hz for 16 fixed seeds and 600 simulated seconds each, with an exact seed-42 replay. These collision-independent streams are not natural player run lengths.
Stationary contact probes use actual calibrated HazardCollision queries; radius, phase and rotation remain real. A metadata corridor change is not a mandatory player maneuver.
One diagram plots actual existing generator output. Three conceptual figures are hand-positioned illustrations, explicitly labelled as unimplemented and uncertified; none is a fake game screenshot.

Research JSON includes methods, full seed-42 events, per-seed distributions, protected-source hashes, conclusions and limitations. Timing describes the existing-generator diagnostic, not future validator or phone performance.
The four required checks retain every existing assertion. Deliberate recoverable asset-404 cases are expected test fixtures; other browser flows require clean errors.
limitations: External architecture approval is required before GAMEPLAY-001B. Proposed parameter values, budgets and acceptance targets are not measured results or approved tuning.

Finite witness search proves only a checked trajectory from its exact publication state under the documented dynamics/collision contract; no all-input, continuous-state or human-reaction guarantee is claimed.
State-aware acceptance is proposed to depend on input history as well as seed. Replay semantics and exploitability need review.
No future generator rejection rate, validator benchmark, clearance distribution or human-playtest outcome exists yet.
Physical phones, Safari/Firefox, sustained sessions and assistive-technology acceptance remain unverified. Existing Vite chunk advisory remains.
